items.name: Long-term AI memory partnership with NVIDIA
items.claim: SK hynix entered into a long-term AI memory partnership with NVIDIA to secure and co-develop next-generation AI memory, including HBM.
items.source_excerpt: SK hynix is also entering into a long-term AI memory partnership with NVIDIA.

items.name: SK Group / NVIDIA $500B+ AI factory and memory initiative
items.claim: SK Group and NVIDIA announced a $500 billion plus initiative spanning AI factories and next-generation memory, including SK Telecom's 2-gigawatt NVIDIA Vera Rubin, DSX AI Factory.
items.source_excerpt: SK Group and NVIDIA expand strategic collaboration with a $500 billion plus initiative spanning AI factories and next-generation memory. ▪ SK Telecom to build 2-gigawatt NVIDIA Vera Rubin, DSX AI Factory to serve global compute demand.

notes: Both items sourced from the stored 25 Jul 2026 SK hynix Newsroom press release (data/web/0a6276b2cb09c2b7.json). The Q2 2026 earnings-call transcript queued as a secondary source (REQ-20260914-1314, investing.com) returned HTTP 403 with no text captured, so it carries no item.
